properties.name: Palabora copper open pit
properties.kind: open pit mined 1964 to 2002, now underground
properties.coord_source: OpenStreetMap way 47692302, 'Palabora Mining Company open pit'
properties.note: Open pit mining ended in 2002; ore now comes from an underground block cave below the pit.

properties.name: Tharisa mine
properties.note: Open pit on the western limb of the Bushveld Complex, 35 km east of Rustenburg.

properties.name: DRDGOLD Ergo Brakpan tailings dam
properties.note: Witwatersrand gold is mined underground, so there is no open pit. DRDGOLD retreats old surface gold tailings and its Ergo operation deposits the residue on this dam.
